title.zh: Tornado Cash联创：美国财政部承认混币器规则存在错误
title.en: Tornado Cash联创：美国财政部承认混币器规则存在错误

current_state.zh: Tornado Cash co-founder Roman Storm says the US Treasury acknowledged its mixer rules were flawed and caused a chilling effect on legitimate activity, while the DOJ continues to press for his conviction with a new filing in SDNY.
current_state.en: Tornado Cash co-founder Roman Storm says the US Treasury acknowledged its mixer rules were flawed and caused a chilling effect on legitimate activity, while the DOJ continues to press for his conviction with a new filing in SDNY.
